name: Lisabelle no Ma - Ciel'adan Hen ~Hikari no Vilfona~
original_name: リズベルルの魔 シェラダン篇～光のヴィルフォーナ～
source:
"Reject the seas, twirl heavenward with a prismic chime, Vilfonaaa-----!" 

Guided by a young blind girl named Lisabelle, a man named Jin, burdened by the weight of his past, embarks to the sky city of Ciel'adan in a suit of symbiotic armor called "Vilfona". 

When Jin becomes one with his armor, his heart is cleansed... 

Inspired to protect the city and fulfill a wish long forgotten, and empowered by the magic of Lisabelle, Jin vows to wield Vilfona in the name of righteous good.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE131064.html]DLsite English[/url]]
